answer: Round-trip distance check binds each agent to a network location by enforcing that a challenge sent through a nebula of known relay nodes returns within the speed-of-light round-trip window. At each tide of new identities, nodes compare timestamped responses; a missed window invalidates the identity. An attacker reaches the nadir of cost by provisioning a separate endpoint and route per identity, because one operator cannot fake simultaneous latency across locations.
